# Vendored dependencies

| Header | Pinned version | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| httplib.h | cpp-httplib v0.18.3 | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib/v0.18.3/httplib.h | MIT; LICENSES/cpp-httplib.txt |
| json.hpp | nlohmann/json v3.11.3 | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.11.3/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp | MIT; LICENSES/nlohmann-json.txt |

The application uses plain HTTP on loopback. OpenSSL and compression libraries are not required. Both original downloaded headers and original license notices are retained. No reference scheduler source is vendored. Build and execution do not fetch dependencies.
